special: At the start of your turn, if you have exactly 3 cards in hand, gain 1 action.

sourceRules.duringText: Your opponent discards 1 random card. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.
sourceRules.afterText: If this is your third action, draw 1 card.
If this is your third action this turn, recover 3 health.

sourceRules.duringText: If this is your third action this turn, this card's value is 7 instead.

sourceRules.afterText:
BLOODY REPRISE: 0 ATK
DURING COMBAT: If your opponent played a card against BLOODY REQUIEM, this attack's value is that card's printed value.

sourceRules.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

sourceRules.afterText: You may place Bloody Mary in any empty space adjacent to the opposing fighter.

sourceRules.duringText: You may increase or decrease the value of this card by 1.
sourceRules.afterText: If the value of this card matches your opponent's card, draw 1 card and the opposing fighter takes 2 damage.

sourceRules.duringText: If Bloody Mary shares no zones with the space she started in this turn, this card's value is 6 instead.

sourceRules.basicText: Look at an opponent's hand and choose a card. Your opponent may discard it. If they don't, their hero takes damage equal to its BOOST value.

sourceRules.afterText: Choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 4 spaces.

sourceRules.duringText: The value of this card is equal to the printed value of your opponent's card.

cards.name: Closer Than She Appears

sourceRules.basicText: Move your fighter up to 1 space. Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.

notes: Versions of this card feature the fighter's name instead of "your fighter" in the text.
